name: opencode-dynamic-workflows-monorepo
description: Deterministic multi-subagent Workflow orchestration for OpenCode V2, as a plugin (no core changes).

scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.build: bun run packages/plugin/script/build-tui.ts && bun run --cwd packages/web build && bun run schemas:check
scripts.pack: bun run build && cd packages/plugin && bun pm pack
